To provide equitable, process-driven college guidance to empower students in the Southcoast area who face barriers to higher education.

Three pillars guide
every student's journey.

01

Active Discovery

A cohort-based search model that shifts the focus from "getting in" to "finding fit" through mutual support, self-reflection, and self-advocacy.

02

Narrative Cohesion

Synthesizing transcripts, testing, and extracurriculars into one clear, compelling, and authentic story about each student.

03

Process Driven

Utilizing essential criteria to drive each student's search process from 9th grade through senior year.
